bundles.title: NgAutoPilot Core
bundles.description: Start here for repository intake, stack detection, routing, compatibility checks, risk assessment, and bounded validation.

bundles.title: Angular Complete
bundles.description: Gateway to the complete Angular catalog: architecture, components, forms, router, signals, RxJS, testing, SSR, security, performance, modernization, and upgrades.

bundles.title: Angular Upgrades
bundles.description: All Angular major-by-major upgrade routes, compatibility gates, changelog risk review, and upgrade satellites from Angular 2 through Angular 22.

bundles.title: Angular Microfrontends
bundles.description: Angular microfrontend architecture, host and remote contracts, federation, dependency sharing, release governance, observability, and rollback safety.

bundles.title: Frontend Experience
bundles.description: Framework-neutral frontend guidance for UX, accessibility, responsive design, design systems, visual validation, CSS, and web performance evidence.

bundles.title: Performance and Optimization
bundles.description: Measured Angular and frontend performance work covering Core Web Vitals, rendering, change detection, lists, lazy loading, images, RxJS, budgets, and zoneless readiness.

bundles.title: Engineering Quality
bundles.description: Code-quality and language-safety guidance spanning ESLint, SonarQube, dead code, TypeScript strictness, JavaScript fundamentals, and CSS quality boundaries.

bundles.title: Angular 2-5
bundles.description: Legacy Angular era gateway covering the real Angular 2 to 4 and 4 to 5 upgrade hops without inventing an Angular 3 release.

bundles.title: Angular 6-8
bundles.description: Angular 6 to 8 era gateway covering CLI workspace migration, RxJS 6, HttpClient, compatibility gates, and the bounded hops into and through this era.

bundles.title: Angular 9-12
bundles.description: Angular 9 to 12 era gateway for Ivy adoption, lazy-route modernization, localize, TestBed changes, IE11 governance, and bounded major hops.

bundles.title: Angular 13-15
bundles.description: Angular 13 to 15 era gateway for Ivy-only libraries, typed forms, early standalone adoption, Material MDC, DI, router, and security changes.

bundles.title: Angular 16-17
bundles.description: Angular 16 to 17 era gateway for ngcc removal, Signals, standalone-first architecture, hydration, control flow, defer, and zone changes.

bundles.title: Angular 18-19
bundles.description: Angular 18 to 19 era gateway for testing stability, SSR and router changes, effects scheduling, and standalone-by-default compatibility.

bundles.title: Angular 20-22
bundles.description: Modern Angular 20 to 22 gateway for zoneless APIs, resources, templates, DI, router, SSR, Signal Forms, MCP workflows, and bounded upgrade hops.

bundles.title: NgAutoPilot Full
bundles.description: Explicit all-in gateway to every canonical NgAutoPilot skill family. Use only when broad offline discovery is more important than a focused context window.
